evidence.notes: HAVING can filter on aggregate expressions that are not selected; local AggregateResult rows expose only selected group fields and aggregate aliases.

source.content: @isTest private class DataSoqlUnselectedHavingTest { @isTest static void filtersWithoutProjectingAggregate() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100); insert new Account(Name = 'Gamma', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 300); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 250); List<Object> counted = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING SUM(AnnualRevenue) > 300]; System.assertEquals(1, counted.size()); Object countedRow = counted.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', countedRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(2, countedRow.accountCount); List<Object> groupedOnly = [SELECT Rating FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING SUM(AnnualRevenue) > 300]; System.assertEquals(1, groupedOnly.size()); Object groupedRow = groupedOnly.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', groupedRow.Rating); } }
